mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, title, description, category, level, system_code, status, progress, target_value, start_date, end_date FROM goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE level WHEN 'YEAR' THEN 1 WHEN 'MONTH' THEN 2 WHEN 'WEEK' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, id DESC
SELECT id, parent_id, title, description, category, level, system_code, status, progress, target_value, start_date, end_date FROM goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND level = #{level} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goal(user_id, parent_id, title, description, category, level, system_code, status, progress, target_value, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{g.parentId}, #{g.title}, #{g.description}, #{g.category}, COALESCE(#{g.level}, 'MONTH'), #{g.systemCode}, COALESCE(#{g.status}, 'ACTIVE'), COALESCE(#{g.progress}, 0), #{g.targetValue}, #{g.startDate}, #{g.endDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE goal SET progress = #{progress}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE goal SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM goal WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
